verdict.rationale: Navan's developer portal documents a single API with 12 retrieval endpoints, pagination and field selection. It covers card transactions, Connect card transactions and manual expenses, plus receipts, all behind an OAuth 2.0 client-credentials flow. Scoped tokens are never mentioned, and receipt retrieval appears only in a one-line summary. missing for 10: evidence of scoped/granular token permissions, detailed receipt-retrieval endpoint docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of the API.
